data.body_html:
Imagine spending the afternoon reeling in dorado or tuna off the Costa del Sol, then sipping cava as the sun melts into the Mediterranean. That’s exactly what a Marbella fishing and sunset combo charter 2027 delivers — two iconic experiences in one seamless day. Departing from Puerto Banús, this 8-hour charter combines sport fishing with a sunset cruise, all with a licensed skipper, drinks, snacks, and fuel included. Prices start at €2,299 for up to 12 guests on our Tier A boats.

Why Choose a Fishing and Sunset Combo in Marbella?

Marbella’s coastline offers some of the best fishing grounds in the Mediterranean, with species like dorado, tuna, mackerel, and bream in season. After a productive afternoon, you’ll cruise back along the Golden Mile as the sky turns orange and pink. It’s a full-day adventure that avoids the rush — no early starts, no rushed returns. Just fishing, then sunset.

How the Combo Charter Works

Your day begins at 14:00 at Puerto Banús. The skipper will take you to proven fishing spots off Estepona or Cabopino, depending on conditions. You’ll fish for roughly 4 hours with all tackle and bait provided. Around 18:00, we switch to sunset mode: anchor up, pour a drink, and cruise slowly along the Marbella shoreline as the sun sets behind La Concha. You’ll be back at the marina by 22:00.

Which Boats Are Available?

We offer two pricing tiers for this combo:

  • Tier A (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39): €2,299 for 8 hours, up to 11 guests.
  • Tier B (Mangusta 80 in white or grey): €4,719 minimum 4 hours (includes free jet ski).
  • Other boats (e.g., Ferretti 94, Canados 86, Azimut 58 Flybridge): pricing on request via WhatsApp.

All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish 21% VAT. No hidden fees.

What You’ll Catch

Target species vary by season. From spring to autumn, expect dorado (mahi-mahi), bluefin tuna, mackerel, and bream. Our skippers know the local waters intimately — they’ll take you to the most productive spots off the coast of Marbella, Estepona, and Sotogrande. You keep what you catch, or we can recommend a restaurant in Puerto Banús to cook it for you.

The Sunset Cruise: A Magical Finish

As the fishing lines come in, the real show begins. The sunset from the water is unforgettable — the sky colours reflect off the calm sea, and La Concha mountain frames the horizon. We’ll cruise past the luxury villas of the Golden Mile, the Marbella Marina, and maybe as far as Cabopino. It’s the perfect way to wind down after an active afternoon.

What’s Included in the Price

How to Book

Ready to secure your Marbella boat charter? For Tier A boats, you can book directly online. For Tier B or custom requests (larger yachts, private chefs, extended hours), message us on WhatsApp. We recommend booking at least 2 weeks in advance, especially during July and August. Cancellation policy: full refund if weather forces cancellation; otherwise, 48-hour notice for reschedule.

Tips for the Best Combo Experience

  • Bring sunscreen, a hat, and sunglasses — the sun is strong even in late afternoon.
  • Wear non-slip shoes and light layers; sea breezes can cool you down after sunset.
  • Let the skipper know if you want to focus on a specific fish species.
  • Book a restaurant in Puerto Banús for after the charter — many will prepare your catch.

Frequently asked questions

What time does the fishing and sunset combo charter start?

The combo charter typically departs at 14:00 from Puerto Banús. You’ll fish for about 4 hours, then cruise into the sunset from around 18:00 to 22:00. Exact timings are adjusted for seasonal sunset times.

Which boats are available for this combo charter?

Our Tier A boats – Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – start at €2,299 for 8 hours. Larger vessels like the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) are available from €4,719 for 4+ hours, including a free jet ski. All depart from Puerto Banús.

Is fishing equipment included?

Yes, we provide all fishing tackle, bait, and safety gear. Our skipper knows the best spots off Marbella and Estepona. You just bring your enthusiasm – we handle the rods, reels, and lines.

Can we keep the fish we catch?

Absolutely. You can keep your catch, and our crew can even recommend local restaurants in Puerto Banús or Marbella that will prepare it for you. Catch-and-release is also welcome.

What is included in the sunset part of the charter?

After fishing, we cruise along the Marbella coastline as the sun sets behind La Concha. You’ll enjoy unlimited water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. It’s a relaxed, scenic end to the day.

How many guests can join the combo charter?

Capacity depends on the boat. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) hold up to 9–11 guests. Larger yachts like the Ferretti 94 or Mangusta 80 can host up to 12 guests. Check our fleet page for exact capacities.

Do I need a fishing license?

No, our skipper holds the necessary licenses. You just enjoy the experience. All safety and legal requirements are covered under our insurance and skipper’s credentials.

What happens if the weather is bad?

We monitor conditions closely. If the forecast is unsafe, we’ll reschedule or offer a full refund. Your safety and comfort are our priority.
